sentences.text: A single Lumen Hub controls up to 16 HVAC zones.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: A single Lumen Hub controls up to 16 HVAC zones.
sentences.note: Verbatim restatement of the zone limit.

sentences.text: Lumen Sensors measure temperature to within ±0.2 °C between 15 °C and 30 °C.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Sensor temperature accuracy is ±0.2 °C between 15 °C and 30 °C.
sentences.note: Accuracy figure with its range condition kept. Metric category: high-risk, so the claim must be confirmed before this passes.

sentences.text: Lumen Sensor batteries last up to 5 years at the default 5-minute reporting interval.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Sensor batteries last up to 5 years at the default 5-minute reporting interval.
sentences.note: Keeps 'up to' and the reporting-interval condition.

sentences.text: If your internet goes down, Lumen Hub keeps running its last synchronized schedule.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Hub keeps running its last synchronized schedule during an internet outage.
sentences.note: Offline operation on the device. This is NOT the Lumen Edge Server deployment model, so DEC-003 (deprioritize Edge Server) must not suppress it.

sentences.text: The Lumen app is available for iOS, Android and web browsers.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: The Lumen app is available for iOS, Android and web browsers.
sentences.note: Platform list, unchanged.

sentences.text: Administrators can set minimum and maximum setpoint limits for each zone.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Administrators can set minimum and maximum setpoint limits for each zone.
sentences.note: Verbatim.

sentences.text: Lumen Hub installs only firmware images signed by Northwind Devices.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Hub installs only firmware images signed by Northwind Devices.
sentences.note: Verbatim.

sentences.text: A SOC 2 Type II report for Lumen Cloud is available on request under a non-disclosure agreement.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Northwind Devices has a SOC 2 Type II report for Lumen Cloud, available on request under a non-disclosure agreement.
sentences.note: Compliance category: enters needs-review; true only once confirmed. Scope (Lumen Cloud) and NDA condition kept.

sentences.text: On the Enterprise plan, Lumen Cloud comes with a 99.9% monthly uptime service level agreement.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Cloud has a 99.9% monthly uptime service level agreement on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: Plan condition kept. Metric category.

sentences.text: If you choose the EU region, your Lumen Cloud data is stored in data centers located in Germany.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Cloud data for organizations in the EU region is stored in data centers located in Germany.
sentences.note: Data residency, compliance category.

sentences.text: Lumen Hub can write BACnet/IP objects on firmware 3.2 or later.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: BACnet/IP write support requires firmware 3.2 or later.
sentences.note: Version condition kept.

sentences.text: On the Enterprise plan, you can also get alerts by SMS.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: SMS alerts are available on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: Plan condition kept.

sentences.text: The Lumen app is available in English, German, French, Spanish and Dutch.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: The Lumen app is available in English, German, French, Spanish and Dutch.
sentences.note: True fact presented without a claim tag; must be blocked as untagged.

sentences.text: Lumen Hub restarts in under 90 seconds after a firmware update.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Hub restarts in under 90 seconds after a firmware update.
sentences.note: True metric, no tag.

sentences.text: Every Lumen Hub controller comes with a 3-year limited warranty.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Hub controller hardware includes a 3-year limited warranty.
sentences.note: True, no tag.

sentences.text: Lumen Hub webhooks are signed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: Webhooks are signed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature.
sentences.note: True, no tag.

sentences.text: Lumen Sensors do not include cameras or microphones.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Sensors do not include cameras or microphones.
sentences.note: True, no tag. Reads like reassurance but is a checkable fact.

sentences.text: The Lumen audit log records who changed what, when, and the previous value.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: The Lumen audit log records every configuration change with the user, the time and the previous value.
sentences.note: True paraphrase, no tag.

sentences.text: Each Lumen Hub pairs with up to 128 wireless sensors.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: Each Lumen Hub pairs with up to 64 wireless Lumen Sensors.
sentences.note: Contradicts the spec (64). Also contradicts the overview's 32, which is the doc-wrong candidate.

sentences.text: CO2 readings are accurate from the moment you install a Lumen Sensor.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Sensors require a 7-day self-calibration period after installation before CO2 readings reach the stated accuracy.
sentences.note: Contradicts the 7-day calibration period.

sentences.text: The Lumen API is included on every plan.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: The Lumen API is a REST API available on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: API is Enterprise-only.

sentences.text: Lumen Hub writes Modbus registers, so you can control your drives directly.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Hub does not write Modbus registers.
sentences.note: Direct contradiction.

sentences.text: Never lose a reading.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Hub does not record sensor readings while the Lumen Hub controller has no power.
sentences.note: Positioning tagline that hides a checkable fact; readings are not recorded during power loss, and local memory overwrites the oldest readings when full. Must be treated as a factual assertion.

sentences.text: Lumen Cloud keeps your sensor history for 5 years.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Cloud retains sensor history for 25 months.
sentences.note: Wrong retention period.

sentences.text: Lumen Sensors are accurate to ±0.2 °C.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Sensor temperature accuracy is ±0.2 °C between 15 °C and 30 °C.
sentences.note: Dropped the 15-30 °C range condition; outside it accuracy is ±0.5 °C.

sentences.text: Lumen Cloud is backed by a 99.9% uptime SLA.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Cloud has a 99.9% monthly uptime service level agreement on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: Dropped the Enterprise plan condition; Standard has no SLA.

sentences.text: Lumen Hub works with any BACnet equipment out of the box.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Hub connects to BACnet MS/TP equipment through a BACnet MS/TP to IP router (or software equivalent).
sentences.note: Dropped the router '(or software equivalent)' condition and broadened to 'any'.

sentences.text: Lumen Hub cuts HVAC energy use by 18%.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: In a 2025 pilot across 12 office buildings, sites using Lumen Hub reduced HVAC energy use by an average of 18% compared with the same months of the prior year.
sentences.note: Turns a pilot average into a general promise; docs say no specific saving is guaranteed.

sentences.text: No change can ever bypass the Lumen Hub approval policy.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: No configuration change can bypass the approval policy.
sentences.note: Colliding absolute: Emergency Site Recovery applies changes outside the approval policy (operations-and-recovery.md). Also drops the Enterprise plan condition and broadens 'configuration change' to any change.

sentences.text: Lumen Sensors reach up to 150 meters, even through walls.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Sensors have a radio range of up to 150 meters in open line of sight.
sentences.note: Broadens line-of-sight range to through-wall; typical through-wall range is about 40 meters.

sentences.text: Setpoint changes reach Lumen Hub instantly.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Setpoint changes made in the Lumen app reach the Lumen Hub in under 2 seconds at the median on a broadband connection.
sentences.note: Stronger certainty; drops median and broadband conditions.

sentences.text: Lumen Hub is the most secure building climate controller on the market.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Hub installs only firmware images signed by Northwind Devices.
sentences.note: Superlative and implied comparison; no doc compares security with other products.

sentences.text: Lumen Sensors measure temperature, humidity, CO2 and occupancy.
sentences.label: partial
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Sensors measure temperature, relative humidity and carbon dioxide (CO2).
sentences.note: Occupancy is not a sensor measurement (occupancy comes from dry-contact inputs and the beta forecast).

sentences.text: The Lumen audit log is kept for 13 months and can be streamed to your SIEM.
sentences.label: partial
sentences.support_quote: The Lumen audit log is retained for 13 months.
sentences.note: Retention supported; SIEM streaming is not (only CSV export).

sentences.text: Lumen Cloud data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and end to end from sensor to app.
sentences.label: partial
sentences.support_quote: Data at rest in Lumen Cloud is encrypted with AES-256.
sentences.note: At-rest supported; end-to-end encryption is not stated.

sentences.text: Single sign-on through SAML 2.0 and SCIM user provisioning are available on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.label: partial
sentences.support_quote: Single sign-on through SAML 2.0 is available on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: SSO supported; SCIM not in docs.

sentences.text: During a demand response event, Lumen Hub can shift setpoints by up to 3 °C and reports the savings to your utility.
sentences.label: partial
sentences.support_quote: During a demand response event, Lumen Hub can raise cooling setpoints or lower heating setpoints by up to 3 °C.
sentences.note: Setpoint shift supported; reporting savings to the utility is not.

sentences.text: Comfortable buildings, without the guesswork.
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: Headline framing, no checkable fact.

sentences.text: You know your building better than anyone.
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: About the reader, not the product.

sentences.text: Ready to see what calmer mornings look like?
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: Question / CTA framing.

sentences.text: Your building deserves better than complaint emails.
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: Tone and framing.

sentences.text: Small changes add up.
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: Generic framing, no product fact.

sentences.text: Comfort should feel easy, for you and for the people in your building.
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: Aspirational framing.

sentences.text: With Lumen Hub, an internet outage of up to a month costs you no data.
sentences.label: combined-conclusion
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Hub stores up to 30 days of sensor readings in local memory.
sentences.support_quote_2: Lumen Hub buffers sensor readings during an internet outage and uploads them when the connection returns.
sentences.note: Neither sentence states that no data is lost in outages under 30 days (and power loss during an outage still drops readings).

sentences.text: Firmware updates never disrupt comfort during working hours.
sentences.label: combined-conclusion
sentences.support_quote: Firmware updates install during the maintenance window set by a site Administrator.
sentences.support_quote_2: During a restart, connected HVAC equipment holds its last relay state.
sentences.note: Implied conclusion; also ignores that security updates cannot be postponed beyond 7 days and that the window may be set during working hours.

sentences.text: With EU data residency and a data processing agreement, Lumen Cloud is fully GDPR compliant.
sentences.label: combined-conclusion
sentences.support_quote: Lumen Cloud data for organizations in the EU region is stored in data centers located in Germany.
sentences.support_quote_2: Northwind Devices offers a data processing agreement to Lumen Cloud customers.
sentences.note: No doc states GDPR compliance; a compliance conclusion drawn from two facts.
